subject: VerdantBank DDQ & retention alignment — post-call follow-up
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baker <tbaker@verdantbank.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@verdantbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: VerdantBank DDQ & retention alignment — post-call follow-up

Hi Tom / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap to make sure we captured the key items and to surface the artifacts we promised:

Pain / goals (what I heard)
- You need an inference partner that can provide: SOC 2 evidence, 12–24 month retention for certain audit logs, and on-demand pen-test reports for major platform upgrades.
- Goal is to have an operational acceptance checklist for Legal & Infosec by the end of May so procurement can move to PO.

Open / agreed items
- SOC 2: we can provide scope summary and the most recent Type II report. (attachment: SOC2_summary-v2.pdf)
- Audit logs: Redwood currently streams high-fidelity request logs for 90 days; we discussed extended retention for a subset (security audit bucket) to 18 months at object-level replication — this will require a short-term dedicated bucket and a retention policy.
- DPA: you sent an initial redline. We will circulate a proposed DPA update that maps retention and audit responsibilities (attachment: DPA-redline-verdant.docx).
- Pen test: we can provide the most recent external pentest report and propose a regular cadence + an on-demand window before Prod cutover.

Immediate next steps (owners & ETA)
- Marissa: attach SOC2 summary + recommended artifact mapping for your DDQ by EOD Fri (May 14).
- Jordan: share a draft statement of work and staging window options so procurement can scope costs by Mon (May 17).
- I (Irene): coordinate DPA redlines with Legal and provide a one-page retention options matrix by Mon (May 17).

Attachments included: VerdantBank_DDQ_notes.pdf (call notes), SOC2_summary-v2.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv (sample snippet), DPA-redline-verdant.docx

Questions for you
1) Confirm which log types you need retained 12+ months (request metadata vs full request bodies).
2) Any minimum encryption/KMS requirements for long-term buckets we should know?
3) Confirm preferred pen-test window (we suggested a 2-week window in June; does that work?)

Thanks — if that looks right, reply with confirmations and we’ll kick off the owners above.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: 4 (VerdantBank_DDQ_notes.pdf; SOC2_summary-v2.pdf; audit-log-sample.csv; DPA-redline-verdant.docx)

From: Tom Baker <tbaker@verdantbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@verdantbank.com>, security_team@verdantbank.com, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VerdantBank DDQ & retention alignment — post-call follow-up

Irene — thanks for the detailed recap, this is helpful. A few clarifications from Infosec: 

- Retention: we only need bodies for flagged requests tied to investigations; everything else can be metadata. So 18 months for flagged full bodies, 24 months for metadata is our preference.
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the long-term archive — where possible.
- Pen test: June 7–18 looks possible for the vendor window; we need a cert from your vendor that no PII or sensitive customer data will be exposed in the report.

We'll review the SOC2 summary and DPA redline and come back with specifics by Mon EOD.

Tom
Tom Baker
Head of Risk, Verdant Bank
